summary: o-89202ed867c6b9f2: the old harness cannot reach printing a constructed cJSON_Raw object member on either side of g0002.

claims.necessity_reason: Object printing is in the harness's operational surface. A shallow object can contain a supported Raw member whose value is printed verbatim, but the fixed harness prints only parsed trees. Object parsing uses parse_value, whose complete dispatcher cannot create Raw; the harness has no construction route.

before.requirement: Reach print_object printing a constructed cJSON_Raw member value in a shallow object.
before.reason: print_object delegates member values to the Raw-capable print_value. The public AddRawToObject helper can create that state, while parsed object members cannot be Raw.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines verbatim rendering of a Raw member value.
Provides a supported way to construct a Raw object member.
Parsed object members obtain their values through parse_value.
The complete value dispatcher has no Raw-producing case.

after.requirement: Reach print_object printing a constructed cJSON_Raw member value in a shallow object.
after.reason: The new depth guard permits a shallow object, and member printing still delegates to the Raw-capable print_value. The old harness still has only the parse route to obtain its tree.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Raw member values remain printable verbatim.
The supported Raw object member construction route remains available.
Parsed object members still obtain their values through parse_value.
The complete value dispatcher still has no Raw-producing case.

claims.comparison_reason: Both source versions support the same Raw object member print behavior. On both sides, the same old harness constraint blocks it: the entry prints a tree obtained solely from parsing and never constructs or inserts a Raw member.
